entries.jp: {FFEE}盗賊に狙われた女性を救え！{FFF1}
{v:0025}そうだ！{n}こんな時にこそ、マスターにもらった道具を{n}使うのよ！
entries.en: {v:0025}Oh, right! This is just the time to use that item Master{n}gave us!

entries.jp: {v:0026}何してんのよ！{p}{v:0027}アイテムの中から『{FFEF}シビレ玉{FFF1}』を使うんだってば！
entries.en: {v:0026}What are you doing?!{p}{v:0027}I said to use the '{FFEF}Paralysis Orb{FFF1}' from your items!

entries.jp: {v:001B}ほら、何してんのよ！{n}あの人、連れて行かれちゃうでしょ！
entries.en: {v:001B}Hey, what are you doing?! They're going to take{n}her away!

entries.jp: {FFEE}マップ端に連れ去られるな！{FFF1}
entries.en: {FFEE}Don't let them take her to the edge of the map!{FFF1}

entries.jp: {v:001C}おっと！{n}ここからは行かせねぇぜ！
entries.en: {v:001C}Whoa there! You ain't getting past me!

entries.jp: {v:001D}邪魔されるわけにゃいかねぇからな！
entries.en: {v:001D}Can't have you getting in our way!
{v:0028}Hang on! We're coming to save you!

entries.jp: {v:0064}バカ、バカ！{n}連れてかれちゃったじゃないの！
entries.en: {v:0064}You idiot! You idiot! They got away with her!

entries.jp: あ、そうだ！{n}コレ、預かってたんだっけ‥‥。
entries.en: Oh, right! I was given this to hold on to...

entries.jp: おい！{n}お前らも、娘を狙え！{n}その小僧なら、無視してもいい！
entries.en: Hey! You lot go after the girl too! You can ignore{n}that brat!

entries.jp: {v:0050}いいか、あのゼノスって奴は相当腕がたつぞ！{n}気をつけろ！
entries.en: {v:0050}Listen up! That Xenos guy's damn good! Watch{n}yourselves!

entries.jp: {v:0051}さっきので十分わかりましたぜ。
entries.en: {v:0051}Yeah, I got a good taste of that just now.

entries.jp: {v:0052}それに俺たちの仕事は奴の妹の方だ！{n}失敗は許されねぇぞ！
entries.en: {v:0052}Besides, our job's to grab his sister! Failure ain't{n}an option!
{v:001F}I won't let you villains get away with this!

entries.jp: {v:0020}何だ？{n}今の声はどこから聞こえたんだ？
{v:0021}どこ見てんのよ！{n}アタシは、ココよ！
entries.en: {v:0021}Where are you looking?! I'm right here!

entries.jp: {v:0022}な、なんだ？{n}妖精が人間と一緒にいるだと？{p}{v:0023}だが、妖精に何が出来る！
entries.en: {v:0022}Wh-what? A fairy with a human?{p}{v:0023}But what can a fairy do?!

entries.jp: {v:0024}ムッカ～～ッ！{n}絶対、こいつやっつけちゃってよね！
クソッ！{n}もう追い付きやがったか！
{v:0055}何だ？{n}女みてぇな声だしやがって？
{v:0056}女みたいじゃなくて、アタシは女の子なの！
entries.en: {v:0056}I don't just sound like a girl! I AM a girl!

entries.jp: {v:0057}よ、妖精だと？{p}{v:0058}へへっ！{n}こんなに人なつこい妖精は初めて見たぜ！{n}よし、捕まえて売り飛ばしてやる！
entries.en: {v:0057}A-a fairy?{p}{v:0058}Heh heh! Never seen a fairy so friendly with people!{n}Right, I'll catch you and sell you off!
{v:005A}How dare you do this to Karen!

entries.jp: {v:005C}なに、アイツ！{n}盗賊風情のくせになかなかやるじゃん！
entries.en: {v:005C}What's with him?! He's pretty good for a lousy bandit!

entries.jp: {v:005E}フン！{n}盗賊風情がなかなかやるじゃないか。
entries.en: {v:005E}Hmph! You're pretty good for a lousy bandit.

entries.jp: {v:005D}盗賊風情とは何だ！{n}このオズワルド様を甘く見るなよ！
entries.en: {v:005D}Who're you calling a lousy bandit?! Don't underestimate{n}the great Oswald!

entries.jp: {v:0065}きゃーーっ！{n}ちょっと、起きてよ！{n}目を開けてよーーっ！
entries.en: {v:0065}Aaaah! Hey, wake up! Open your eyes!

entries.jp: さぁ、急いであの人を助けましょ！
entries.en: Come on, let's hurry and save her!

entries.jp: ちっ！{n}そう簡単に追い付かれてたまるかよ！
entries.en: Tch! You ain't catching up to me that easily!

entries.jp: {v:002A}ぐおっ！{p}{v:002B}す、すまねぇ‥オズワルドのアニキ‥‥。

entries.en: {v:002C}We did it!{p}{v:002D}Hey, are you all right?

entries.jp: {v:002F}ん？{n}何で、まだ娘がここにいるんだ？
{v:0032}何ボヤボヤしてんだよ！{n}せっかく俺が奴の注意を引きつけていたってのに！
entries.en: {v:0032}What're you standing around for?! I went to all that{n}trouble to keep him distracted!

entries.jp: {v:0035}こうなったら俺が直接やるしかねぇ！
entries.en: {v:0035}Looks like I'll have to do it myself!

entries.jp: {v:0036}どうやらあいつが親玉みたいね！
何と指示を与えますか？
entries.en: What will you tell her to do?

entries.jp: {v:0039}そうね。{n}ヘンに動かれると守りづらいモンね！
entries.en: {v:0039}Right! It's harder to protect her if she's running all{n}over the place!

entries.jp: {v:003A}わかりました。{n}ここにいます。
{v:003B}アタシ達が敵と戦っているうちに街の方へ逃げて！
entries.en: {v:003B}Run toward town while we fight the enemy!

entries.jp: {v:003D}コイツから離れちゃダメだよ！
{v:0066}くそっ！{n}まさかこんなことになるとは‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0066}Damn! Never thought it'd turn out like this...

entries.jp: {v:003F}こんなところに居やがったか！{n}お前、何の恨みがあって俺を‥‥。
entries.en: {v:003F}So this is where you've been hiding! What've I ever done{n}to you that you'd...

entries.jp: {v:0040}チッ！{n}もう戻って来やがったか！
{v:0043}お兄さんなの？{n}あなたの妹さんが、この悪漢にさらわれそうに{n}なってるのよ！
entries.en: {v:0043}You're her brother? This villain's trying to kidnap{n}your sister!

entries.jp: {v:0044}何だと！　よくもカレンを！
entries.en: {v:0044}What?! How dare you do this to Karen!

entries.jp: {v:0066}くそっ！{n}まさかこんなことになるとは‥‥。{p}{v:0067}ええい、引き上げだ！
entries.en: {v:0066}Damn! Never thought it'd turn out like this...{p}{v:0067}Damn it, we're pulling out!

entries.jp: {v:005F}何だと！？{n}俺の子分を倒しただと？
{v:0045}ちょっと待ってよ！{n}今は協力するべきだと思わない？
entries.en: {v:0045}Hold on! Don't you think we should work together{n}right now?
...{v:0046}All right. What do you want me to do?

entries.jp: さぁ、次は何をすればいい？
entries.en: Right, what do I do next?

entries.jp: ゼノスに何と指示を出しますか？
entries.en: What orders will you give Xenos?
・Let him fight as he sees fit

entries.jp: {v:0048}では、私は兄さんのところへ行くんですね？
entries.en: {v:0048}Then I should go to my brother, is that right?

entries.jp: {v:004A}それじゃ、どうするんだ？{p}{v:004B}さっさと決めてくれ！
entries.en: {v:004A}So, what's it gonna be?{p}{v:004B}Hurry up and decide!

entries.jp: {v:004D}わかった！{p}{v:004E}覚悟しやがれ、この野郎！
entries.en: {v:004D}Got it!{p}{v:004E}You're in for it now, you bastard!
